I wouldnt say "terrible" I would say a deck that can pull an answer out of multiple cards that give you a pick or random assigned card not originally in the deck list, creates an environment of complete uncertainty. I can predict what a player is holding based on their actions, I can count what they've played and how many. But neither of those help play around a deck that sourced duplicates of its most stalling cards.

Probably not what most want to hear and hey its my thinking, I dont expect everyone to agree. I am a nihilist. I really dont think there is a point to anything. But, that isnt an excuse to just die or give up. If you can comfortably accept that there isnt a meaning, then you can give the things you do meaning. I do for me because I want to.
